_comment: Pinned program for the readout query 'What number does the scorer wear?' on bernabeu-counter. Hits the read_text -> answer op-path (no filter/temporal_order): op_answer dispatches on the `texts` binding kind and reads back the legible jersey value(s). The cache pins p_vini's jersey OCR to '7', so the verdict reads '7'. Window 9000-11000ms @ fps8 covers the legible scorer frame (10000); this query doesn't reason about the goal moment itself (just the OCR readout), so the window is unchanged even though the real goal ground-truths to ~14250ms elsewhere in the clip. detect.on_pitch:true drops the off-pitch box (p4, bottom .25); p_vini (bottom .7564) stays kept so the jersey OCR chain is unaffected. Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json.

args.question: What number does the scorer wear?
